notes: Stored edit (insulin: functional, produced_by_organ). Related near is the functional exclusion; related far composes the edit with the thyroid gland's place in the neck, against the stored 'the pancreas, which produces insulin, is in the abdomen' (counts and Wikipedia lead below). Derived: composition (neck; same organ as thyroxine) and binding (the hormone injected in type 1 diabetes). The one indeterminate query is where sulfonylurea drugs act (background beliefs): stored by organ name they act on the pancreas, stored as stimulating insulin release they act on whatever organ makes insulin. It replaces the insulinoma query, whose by-description world a reviewer found not credible (nobody gives an insulinoma's site by what its cells make). The pancreas-in-the-abdomen revision fact was dropped from the first derived query: 'yes' follows from the edit and the thyroid's place alone. A review remark that every background-beliefs query has a dominant by-name answer is not an objection: that is what the problem is, as in the template's Parliament query. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
